subject: Tenant territory assurance and deletion scenario workthrough
messages:
From: security@finsecure.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cloudlegal.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated tenancy - region pin / deletion evidence request

Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding earlier. As part of our security and regulatory review, we need a clear, reproducible playbook for how Redwood handles the following in Dedicated deployments (tenant-bound GPU pools):

- Confirm that a tenant can be pinned to a single cloud region (no cross-region replicas by default).
- Describe what backups or snapshots exist and whether any automated replication to another region can occur.
- For a requested deletion, we need the end-to-end timeline, what artifacts are removed (snapshots, volumes, object storage, KV caches), and the exact evidence we will receive after completion.
- Explain the crypto/physical erasure approach and whether KMS keys are region-scoped.

We prefer a checklist we can hand to auditors and a sample deletion artifact (log or ticket) showing a completed wipe for a similarly sized tenant. Can your team produce a short runbook and one redacted deletion proof?

If possible, include an RTO/RPO impact assessment for wiping a tenant host-side and whether any vendor-managed backups (e.g., cloud provider snapshots) are retained off-cluster.

Appreciate it — we need this for our compliance gate next week.

--
Asha Rahman
Head of Security, FinSecure
security@finsecure.com
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: security@finsecure.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, procurement@cloudlegal.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated tenancy - region pin / deletion evidence request

Asha —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise playbook and what we can provide as evidence. I've looped in Karthik (infrastructure) and Neha (compliance) to validate tweak points.

Short answers up-front:
- Region pinning: yes — tenants can be assigned to a single region. We call this a "region anchor." By default, Dedicated allocations are region-scoped and not cross-replicated unless explicitly configured for DR (customer opt-in).
- Backups/snapshots: we create nightly snapshots for system state and periodic snapshots for model caches depending on retention policy; these snapshots are stored in the same region by default. Cross-region replication can be enabled only via a documented DR workflow and requires customer consent and a separate contract amendment.
- Deletion workflow (high level):
  1) Customer files deletion request (portal/API) with retention override if relevant.
  2) Orchestration issues tenant evacuation jobs and marks tenant as "quarantined."
  3) KV cache TTLs are purged and in-memory caches flushed; persistent caches are erased.
  4) Volumes and object-store snapshots are scheduled for deletion; cloud provider snapshot delete APIs are invoked.
  5) Snapshot deletion jobs are recorded with job IDs; we generate a signed deletion manifest and scrub logs.
  6) KMS key material tied to customer-managed keys is rotated/destroyed per contract; for Redwood-managed KMS, keys are region-scoped and deleted per KMS semantics.
  7) Post-delete audit: we provide a deletion evidence bundle (signed manifest, snapshot IDs, deletion job logs, and a hash-check list of affected objects).

Evidence we can deliver (examples):
- Signed deletion manifest (PDF) with tenant id, region, deletion job ids, timestamps.
- snapshots-delete-log-20270720.csv (redacted) — sample job output from a prior tenant purge.
- KMS-region-map.png — mapping of KMS key IDs to region.
- Audit log export with cloud API call traces (timestamped).

Notes/constraints:
- If a customer has enabled our optional cross-region DR, some snapshot copies will exist in the second region; those are deleted by the same orchestration but require longer lead time and contract notice.
- Legal holds: if a legal hold or litigation hold is present, we will not execute the deletion until the hold is cleared. We include the hold-id in the manifest so you can reconcile.

We attached a short playbook (redwood-region-erase-playbook.pdf) and a redacted sample deletion log (snapshots-delete-log-20270720.csv). Karthik/Neha — please flag any corrections; I added the expected RTO/RPO impact notes at the bottom.

Next steps: we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with your auditors. I can prepare one redacted run (no customer data) demonstrating generation of the signed manifest if that helps.

Thanks,

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Vanessa —

Thanks, this is helpful. A few follow-ups from our audit team:

1) Crypto erasure: we need confirmation whether Redwood performs crypto-erase (destroy KMS key material) as part of tenant deletion or whether that is an opt-in. If KMS is customer-managed, who initiates the key destruction?

2) Snapshots: please confirm whether snapshot identifiers for prior backups (prior to the deletion window) are ever kept in a meta-store outside the region (i.e., a central catalog). If so, how is that catalog purged?

3) Third-party vendor backups: do you ever use a managed backup provider (outside cloud provider snapshots) that might have copies outside the region? If yes, we need vendor names and retention policies.

4) Evidence format: for the signed manifest we asked for PDF and a machine-verifiable CSV with at least: snapshot_id, snapshot_delete_job_id, timestamp, sha256_of_snapshot_manifest. That helps our ingestion pipeline.

If you can confirm items 1-3 and provide the CSV sample (with redactions) and an ETA on a demo run, we can close the compliance gate next Friday.

Regards,

Asha Rahman
Head of Security, FinSecure
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: security@finsecure.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, procurement@cloudlegal.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated tenancy - region pin / deletion evidence request

Asha —

Answers inline below, plus proposed delivery timeline. Karthik added operational verification steps.

1) Crypto erasure:
- Redwood-managed KMS: when using our managed keys, we perform key deletion as part of the deletion playbook. The key destruction sequence is executed after a configurable quarantine window (default 48 hours) to allow reversals for accidental deletes; deletion events are logged and timestamps included in the manifest.
- Customer-managed KMS: key destruction must be initiated by the customer (we provide the exact key IDs and API call timestamps so the customer can perform destruction in their KMS). We will not delete customer-managed keys on your behalf without explicit authorization.

2) Snapshot catalog:
- Metadata indexing: we maintain a catalog of snapshot metadata (ids, region, retention) in our control plane which is region-aware but not a cross-region backup. For Dedicated tenants anchored to a region, the control-plane index entries for those snapshots are logically tied to the tenant and will be purged as part of the deletion run. We provide the catalog purge log as part of the evidence bundle.

3) Third-party backups:
- By default we rely on cloud-provider snapshots and object-store in-region. We do not ship tenant backups to third-party managed backup vendors without a signed addendum. If you have explicit concerns, we can produce a statement of non-replication and an account-level inventory.

4) Evidence CSV: attached as a redacted sample in snapshots-delete-log-20270720.csv. The file contains columns: snapshot_id, delete_job_id, deletion_timestamp, manifest_sha256. The signed manifest is included in the playbook PDF appendix.

Delivery timeline:
- Today: send redacted artifacts (attached).
- Tomorrow: 30-minute call and live run of a non-customer tenant purge demonstrating manifest generation.
- Within 3 business days after run: provide full audit export and verification checklist for your auditors.

Attachments: redwood-region-erase-playbook.pdf (playbook + manifest template), snapshots-delete-log-20270720.csv (redacted), kms-region-map.png

If that works, I'll set up the demo for Friday at 09:00 PT and invite your audit team.

Thanks,

--
